seoTitle: Sell an Ebook on Squarespace as a PDF Download
metaDescription: List and sell your ebook as a digital download on Squarespace, from uploading the file to publishing the product page.
intro: Squarespace is a solid platform for selling an ebook directly from your own website, with no third-party marketplace fees to worry about. This guide covers creating a Download product, uploading your ebook file, and getting it live for readers to purchase.

steps.heading: Log in and select your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, using Continue with Google if linked, then choose the website where you'll sell your ebook.

steps.heading: Open Products and Services
steps.body: Find the Products and Services section in your dashboard or menu, then click Products to proceed.

steps.heading: Add a Download product
steps.body: Click Add Product and choose the Download option, since ebooks are sold as digital files rather than physical goods.

steps.heading: Name your product and upload the file
steps.body: Give the ebook a catchy, relevant name, then upload the file — PDF is the most widely compatible format for readers.

steps.heading: Customize and publish
steps.body: Add images, a detailed description, and set your price, then publish the product so it's ready for customers to buy.

faq.question: What file format should I use for my ebook?
faq.answer: PDF is recommended since it's widely accessible and ensures no customer is left out due to compatibility issues.

faq.question: Do I need any special plan to sell digital products on Squarespace?
faq.answer: You'll need a plan that includes selling capabilities, since the Download product type is part of Squarespace's commerce features.

faq.question: Can I add reviews to my ebook's product page?
faq.answer: Yes, once you start gathering customer feedback you can display reviews to build trust with future buyers.

faq.question: How do customers receive the ebook after purchase?
faq.answer: Squarespace delivers the uploaded file directly to the customer once their purchase is complete.
